review.intent_summary: Expose changes between caller-declared metrics through derived comparisons with traceable source evidence and single-resolution analysis.

criteria.criterion: Ratios retain the computed value, formula, and original source indexes for each sample.
Differences, supplied-scale residuals, and all/any threshold conditions produce the declared derived values.
Missing sources and zero denominators remain unavailable with a reason rather than becoming zero.
Derived series can be analyzed with the frozen or adaptive single-resolution recipe.

verification_evidence: Executed conversion.json through analyze: the frozen recipe completed and triggered only the relationship at index 14; conversion fell from 0.1 to 8/130 while neither source metric triggered.
Reversed conversion example source inputs and executed analyze again: assertions confirmed original source indexes and the declared formula for every lineage sample.
